prompt: Photorealistic full-length studio photograph of one woman of about 28 in a 1912 walking dress: a narrow ankle-length navy wool skirt, a long fitted hip-length tailored jacket, a white high-necked lace blouse, short leather gloves, laced black ankle boots, and a wide-brimmed hat trimmed with ostrich feathers over her pinned-up hair. The whole body from the top of the head to the soles of the feet is in frame, front view, facing the camera, standing in a relaxed A-pose with the arms held a little away from the body, empty open hands, feet slightly apart and fully visible. Plain light grey seamless background, soft even studio lighting, no cast shadows, no props, no text, no logos. Historically accurate 1912 Edwardian clothing and hair, a natural realistic face, sharp fabric detail.
